_meta.dataset_name: Actuarial Breed Rates (Full Master Breeds Coverage)
_meta.intended_use: Multiply base_monthly_premium_usd by an age factor and then by a state cost multiplier.
_meta.base_rate_definition: base_monthly_premium_usd is an actuarial-style adult baseline (roughly age 1-2 equivalent) derived from current market benchmarks.
_meta.normalization_method: Public anchor breed rates retained where available; remaining breeds modeled from master-breeds feature profile using gradient-boosted regression plus nearest-anchor comparables. Poodle varieties derived from the exact Poodle family anchor with size adjustments.
_meta.breed_selection_basis: Expanded from master-breeds.json to full in-project breed coverage
_meta.sorting: AKC popularity rank ascending where available, then breed_name ascending
